trailhead.label: the Großdorf car park in Kals am Großglockner, the board’s start

cautions: The Kalserbach runs fast beside the path and under the mills: keep your dog out of the water.
Wooden bridges and narrow path by the Stockmühlen.
A playground on the way: keep your dog on the path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
